summary: The proposed patch appears to address the issue of offset dash linestyle having no effect in patch objects, but there are some concerns regarding maintainability and potential behavioral regression risk.

issues.description: The patch introduces a complex change by modifying the `draw` method of the `patches` module, which may lead to maintainability issues in the future.
The patch removes the `dashoffset` attribute, which may cause behavioral regression risk if other parts of the code rely on this attribute.
The patch does not include additional tests to verify the fix, which may lead to test overfitting if the fix is not general enough.
